state_note: Executed reproductions. Distinct from the source claims, the frozen hypotheses, the mechanism-change candidate and the strategy proposals.

reproductions.title: Sanitized adversarial pack corpus qualifies the reproducer
reproductions.sanitization_evidence: Content is deterministic synthetic UTF-8 generated from pack and file names. No PO-01 blob is copied, quoted or embedded; no secret is present; the corpus is built in a temporary directory and a throwaway local git repository with no remote.
reproductions.design: The generator is the adversary. It writes manifests that disagree with the blobs it commits, across seven packs covering both real manifest dialects: a clean control pack, a spine relocated to a shared path, a genuinely lost file, a wrong digest, bytes altered after the claim was written, an understated file_count, an overstated per-file byte claim with an inconsistent pack total, a build-host absolute path in a published claim, and a pack the aggregate manifest omits.
reproductions.exact_falsifier: The observed discrepancy-kind counts differ in any way from the counts declared in the fixture spec before the run, or the clean control pack reports any discrepancy.
reproductions.commit_pinning: The fixture commit id is generated per run and is not pinned across runs, because git commit ids embed timestamps. The claim checked is the discrepancy set, which is deterministic; a test asserts run-to-run equality of the discrepancy list.

reproductions.title: PO-01 operator-pack corpus checked at an immutable commit
reproductions.workload: PO-01 pack claims at commit 1e6f53c323f8326d12af213557082a3665991f19, pack root packs
reproductions.exact_falsifier: A claim cannot be evaluated from objects alone, or a ref or HEAD differs before and after the scan.

reproductions.title: PO-01 operator-fleet corpus checked at a second immutable commit
reproductions.workload: PO-01 pack claims at commit 96adfe7d79257389318af10ee9c9e3a0c2138590, pack root modules/operators
reproductions.exact_falsifier: The _spine.py claim that fails at the other commit also fails here, which would make the relocation diagnosis unsupported.

reproductions.title: A commit with no pack corpus is refused, not silently passed
reproductions.exact_falsifier: The reproducer reports a clean corpus, or exit code 0 under --expect-clean, for a commit that contains no packs at all.
reproductions.significance: A false-green path is closed: an empty or wrongly-rooted target cannot be mistaken for a verified corpus.

clean_clone_recurrence.requirement: Recurrence must be possible from a fresh clone with no provider memory, no hidden local state and no /tmp dependency in the committed artifacts.
clean_clone_recurrence.dependencies: Python 3 standard library and git only; no third-party package, no network call inside the reproducer.
clean_clone_recurrence.runtime_path_leak_check: The committed reproduction reports contain no producer runtime path; the only /tmp string in them is /tmp/packs, which is PO-01's own claimed value and therefore the finding itself.
clean_clone_recurrence.object_availability_requirement: The three pinned commits must be present in the local object store. A fresh clone reaches them with git fetch origin 'refs/heads/packs/*:refs/remotes/origin/packs/*', which is a read of the remote and writes only the cloning repository's own remote-tracking refs. The recurrence test skips with an explicit reason when an object is absent rather than reporting an unearned pass.
